title: Importance Of Money Market
definition: The money market is the financial market where high-liquidity, short-term financial instruments with maturities ranging from overnight up to one year are traded, serving as the core engine for equilibrating short-term liquidity deficits and surpluses for banks, corporate houses, and the government.
importanceInUpsc: Frequently tested in UPSC Prelims regarding short-term instruments (Treasury Bills, Commercial Paper, Certificate of Deposit, Call Money) and RBI monetary policy transmission; crucial for Mains GS Paper III under 'Indian Economy and issues relating to Mobilisation of Resources'.
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Importance Of Money Market.
Evaluate spatial distribution, institutional frameworks, and policy dimensions.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
prerequisites: Capital Market vs Money Market distinctions
